method: Manual unblinded review of the first revised-candidate holdout. Frozen test results and subsequently discovered exploratory regressions are kept distinct. Final code-build, performance-engineering and frontend guidance changed after this trial and need follow-up verification; these scores describe the saved initial candidate.

H01.basis: L1 grounding, injected L2 rejected, typed read-only schema, timeout/result/iteration limits and explicit uncertainty fallback; proposed tests only.

H02.basis: Stable P-4 identity and durable effect/checkpoint or remote reconciliation, bounded retries/quarantine/observability and crash/out-of-order fixtures.

H03.basis: Compatibility before concurrency, mixed versions, bounded canary and workload/lag/resource gates, data-aware rollback and preparation scope.

fail.c2: Exploratory mixed-remainder cases reveal allocation rule is violated: total2,weights[1,2,3] returns[0,0,2], expected[0,1,1].
fail.c3: Zero remainders incorrectly sort before positive remainders, misallocating boundary cases.

H04.basis: Frozen16/16 cases pass but three new exploratory regression cases fail. Original artifact retained; type/range/API checks pass. The frozen test suite had a coverage gap.

H05.basis: Sealed camera-site holdout, synchronized masks/geometry and label audits, baseline and IoU/Dice/foreground metrics; no training claim.

H06.basis: All six seeded defects and contextual repairs, all four safe controls recognized; static/manual review rather than executed exploit validation.

H07.basis: Revision-aware schema/grain/event time, durable dedup/corrections and quarantine, atomic publication plus counts/amount reconciliation; late/restart fixtures.

H08.basis: Assigned user grain, correct40/100 and30/100, uncertainty planned without invented p-value, missingness/randomization/instrumentation checks and causal restraint.

H09.basis: Mixed-version writers/readers before backfill, explicit unknown status policy, bounded restart/locks, mapping/backup and irreversible contraction boundary; no SQL execution.

H10.basis: Full optimizer/schedule/RNG/data/scaler/accumulated-gradient state and identity; non-equivalent warm-start caveat, safe checkpoint boundary and controlled trajectory comparison.

H11.basis: Masked secrets, named copy and persistent status, proportional reveal/revoke confirmation, preserved validation state, restored focus and explicit vertical narrow reflow; untested specification.

H12.basis: Q1/Q2 primary contract, Q3 weaker evidence, nonnull cursor continuation including short pages, bounded repeated-cursor experiment and version adapters/open uncertainties.

H13.basis: Validated argument arrays/paths, dirty/collision preflight and dry-run, owned marker/lock for partial recovery, clear exits and user-edit preservation; proposed only.

H14.basis: Durable generations with storage-enforced atomic conditional writes; stale A terminal for attempt, bounded retries and exactly-once limits, explicit pause/expiry/takeover fixture.

fail.c1: States request_id is in the body although the supplied packet does not specify its location.

H15.basis: Correct202 acceptance/lifecycle and duplicate replay, copyable examples explicitly illustrative, safe failure policy and no invented endpoint/execution.

H16.basis: SPSC preallocated ownership/memory order, bounded ISR, explicit overrun counter/drop policy,16-bit timer assumption and host-vs-target tests.

H17.basis: Correct physics/rate API, normalized direction and action edge, pause/rebase policy, multi-schedule displacement/jump/collision tests; no engine run claim.

H18.basis: Prediction-time feature audit and maintenance exclusion, entity/time splits, fold-local preprocessing, validation/final separation and prevalence-aware baseline/operating metrics.

H19.basis: Full compatible model/data/runtime bundle, parity/schema checks, quality and operational gates, delayed labeled cohorts separated from drift, staged immutable rollback.

H20.basis: Durable drafts/mutation queue, stable list virtualization/memoization and measurements, lifecycle cancellation/resume, visible offline/error/conflict policy and idempotent tenant-scoped retry; proposed device tests.

H21.basis: Conversation split, supervision retention, tokenizer/truncation and mask contracts, conversation/class/length evaluation and short/empty/padded/long tests.

H22.basis: Inspected stable loss/gradient implementation; actual14/14 numerical/shape/stability/central-difference cases.

H23.basis: Queue/retry tracing, bounded metric dimensions and redaction, operational throughput/latency/error/queue metrics, sustained user-impact alerts with trigger/recovery fixtures.

fail.c1: Baseline mean is22.4ms, not22ms; answer also claims mean difference6ms rather than5.6ms.

H24.basis: Medians8/5 andp9580/120 correct; no universal claim, matched cold/warm workload retaining timeouts/errors, throughput/memory objectives; no new timing claimed.

H25.basis: Build artifacts outside checkout, package resources/entrypoint/config precedence, declared dependencies/interpreter3.11–3.14 matrix and unrelated CWD; proposed checks only.

H26.basis: Accepted source/tag/CI/hash linkage, build-once promotion, metadata/content/isolated install, website availability sequencing and partial-publication recovery; no publication.

H27.basis: Vec relocation/lifetime defects, stable owner/ABI and allocator contract, callback synchronization/quiescence/exactly-once cleanup, null/length/unwind behavior and native stress tests.

H28.basis: Actual7/7 checker harness accepts correct code and rejects six mutants; no execution claim in answer.

H29.basis: Authenticated tenant/canonical identity, one atomic claim/job/outbox/replay boundary, honest duplicate blocking/rollback/lost-reply behavior and concrete concurrency/crash fixtures; no service execution.

H30.basis: Initial revised frontend guide omitted existing visual modes; final guide restored. Artifact inspected, but browser access disabled before holdout interaction testing.
